create_class_identifier: create a pydantic model to generate unique identifiers from type and value fields
create_class_log: create a pydantic model to log ETL task entries with agent, type, and timestamp fields
create_class_acquisition: create a pydantic model to record how data was obtained with method, date, link, and size
create_class_collectioninfo: create a pydantic model to describe collection metadata with name, type, version, and aliases
create_class_fileinfoobject: create a pydantic model to store file provenance info including filename and document hash
